state.row_3_19_done_when: Masks (add, subtract, intersect, difference; feather; expansion), clip groups, alpha and luma mattes and trim start/end/offset render on the GPU and match CPU references; the scene contract's trim values are honoured; an unsupported combination refuses by name.
today: The contract has no masks, clip groups or track mattes. The scene module says layer masks are owned by row 11.47 (2D object library: pen paths, masks, clip groups, trim paths; not started), which also wants golden-frame tests per object type.
Trim start/end/offset exist on ShapeObject and are honoured at prepare on both paths (since 3.13); trim is not an animatable property, so it is only ever static.

Every object is drawn once at prepare into its own layer texture (Vello coverage, float colour) and the GPU compositor warps and blends those layers per frame; only transform and opacity (and effect parameters) animate.
Groups are hierarchy containers that paint nothing; children are listed by id.

Products the user designs in: After Effects (layer masks with modes add/subtract/intersect/difference/none, feather, expansion, opacity, inverted; track mattes alpha/alpha-inverted/luma/luma-inverted, since 2023 choosing any layer as the matte source), Figma and Photoshop (clipping masks: a shape clips the layers above it in a group).

criteria.object_masks: On each object: ObjectBase.masks, a list of mask paths in the object's own coordinates, each with mode, feather, expansion, opacity and inverted (After Effects).
criteria.mask_objects: As separate scene objects of a new kind that name the object they mask.
criteria.clip_groups_only: No per-object masks; only clip groups.

clip_group.instructions: How should a clip group name its clip shape?

criteria.named_child: GroupObject.clipChildId names one child whose coverage clips the group's other children; the clip child is not drawn itself.
criteria.first_child: The group's first (bottom) child always clips the rest when GroupObject.clip is true (Figma).
criteria.object_flag: Any object can be flagged as a clipping mask for the objects above it in its parent (Photoshop).

matte_source.instructions: How should a track matte name its source?

criteria.explicit_id: ObjectBase.trackMatte {sourceId, mode} names any object as the matte (After Effects 2023 and later).
criteria.layer_above: The object directly above in draw order is the matte (classic After Effects).

when_drawn.instructions: When should masks and clip shapes be drawn?

criteria.prepare_static: At prepare, into coverage multiplied into the layer source, like every other drawing; masks and clip shapes are static (not animatable) until a later row, and anything animated refuses by name.
criteria.per_frame: Every frame, so they can animate.

matte_composite.instructions: A matte source and its consumer move independently. How should mattes composite?

criteria.per_frame_matte_target: Each frame the compositor renders the matte source into its own tile target, and the consumer layer's sample is multiplied by the matte's alpha or luma there.
criteria.bake_at_prepare: Bake the matte into the consumer at prepare, refusing by name when either one animates its transform or opacity.

needs_user.instructions: Does this design need user decisions before implementation (new contract fields, scope against row 11.47)?
